text:
Anna: Quick heads-up — final handoff for the HybridSI partner integration (SIEM + BYO-KMS) is tomorrow. Need: deployment checklist signoff, SAML metadata exchange window, SCIM attribute mappings, and a short joint-announcement blurb. Can we confirm readiness?

Sam: Security checklist review: CMEK key rotation policy confirmed? HSM attestation docs ready? We need to validate the KMS wrapping key usage in the private deployment. :shield:

Devon: From partner ops: marketplace listing draft is waiting on the KMS capability badge. If we can sign off by EOD we can target the integration announcement the following week. Also want to confirm the dedicated capacity SKU mapping.

Priya: Partner update — HybridSI tested BYO-KMS with a mock HSM (PKCS#11) last week. SCIM provisioning mostly green, a couple of custom attrs (departmentId, costCenter) to map. SAML metadata exchange request sent to their IdP (okta) this morning.

Anna: Thanks Priya. Can you paste the SCIM mapping snippet here? Small teams need to verify attribute names match Redwood's directory fields.

Priya: Sure — mapping we used:
```
{
  "externalId": "employeeId",
  "userName": "email",
  "name.givenName": "firstName",
  "name.familyName": "lastName",
  "urn:custom:departmentId": "departmentId",
  "urn:custom:costCenter": "costCenter"
}
```

Sam: Looks fine. Quick reminders: 1) SCIM PATCH support required for our auto-sync. 2) For KMS, enforce envelope encryption with customer-provided key (BYO-KMS) and log key-id usage to audit stream. Add those to the runbook.

Devon: Noted. On the SKU mapping: Dedicated tier -> partner-proxy with 8 vCPU / 2xA100 config for initial pilot. If they need burst we have a documented fallback to hosted small model variant — included in the failure-policy doc.

Maria: Legal: we'll need a 1-paragraph approval for the joint announcement copy referencing the partner and the data flow (no customer data names). Also confirm the trademark usage rules with marketing before publish.

Anna: I'll queue the announcement draft and tag marketing. Maria, can you sign the legal blurb by noon?

Maria: I can do noon. Please include an explicit line about BYO-KMS responsibility split (who stores keys vs who logs usage).

Priya: Partner note — HybridSI engineering will be available during the handoff window (tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT). They prefer to do SAML metadata exchange at start and run an end-to-end smoke test.

Anna: Perfect. OnboardingBot — run quick pre-check and post the checklist status.

OnboardingBot: PRE-CHECK RUN: SCIM: ok; SAML metadata: pending (awaiting partner cert); KMS: ok (mock HSM tested); Marketplace: draft pending; Legal: pending; Ops runbook: attached in Google Drive -> /partnerships/hybridsi/ops-runbook.

Sam: Action items: 1) Priya to upload partner cert (SAML) — due in morning. 2) Anna to finalize announcement draft — due noon. 3) Devon to publish SKU mapping to the marketplace draft — due EOD. 4) Maria to approve legal blurb — due noon. 5) I'll add the runbook KMS enforcement lines.

Priya: Uploaded cert to the shared folder and pinged their IdP admin.

Devon: Marketplace draft updated and linked in the runbook.

Anna: Great — thanks everyone. Meeting at 10am PT tomorrow to do the live handoff. :thumbsup:

OnboardingBot: REMINDER scheduled: 2024-12-12T10:00:00-08:00 — HybridSI handoff.
